definitions.compute_cycles_scale: maximum compute_cycles across tasks in the listed training and pilot instances
definitions.time: cpu_remaining_busy_s, channel_remaining_busy_s, and projected_completion_s are divided by s_M

note: Three training instances (seeds 1000-1002) and three pilot instances (seeds 2000-2002). Held-out instances are not read. Queue lengths stay raw. Values are provisional_not_frozen.
